data.name: Rosamund
data.long_meaning: Rosamund's name is derived from the Old English words 'rosa' and 'mund'. 'Rosa' means 'rose', a symbol of love, beauty, and devotion. 'Mund' means 'protector' or 'defender'. Thus, Rosamund's name means 'strength of the rose' or 'protector of the rose'.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Christian tradition, Rosamund is a symbol of the love and protection of God. It reminds us of the love and strength found in God's presence.

in_greek.name: Ροζαμουντ

Rosamund's name has become synonymous with unrequited love, passion, and loss.
